???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What do we call a place in the program that introduces a name, such as `let width = 128;`?"

        A declaration. Top-level declarations are functions and structs; locals are declared by statements inside blocks.

        Introduced in [Learn: 7. Declarations](../language-tour/10-declarations.md). Specification: [3. Programs and declarations](declarations.md#31-program-structure).

    ??? question "What do we call a name the programmer chose, such as `width` or `Point`?"

        An identifier. It starts with a letter or `_`, continues with letters, digits or `_`, and is case-sensitive.

        Introduced in [Learn: 2. Basic source rules](../language-tour/02-basic-source-rules.md). Specification: [2. Lexical structure](lexical-structure.md#23-identifiers).
